findings.fact: With streaming enabled, current PrefillPath opens a DeviceExpertArena and directs router loads through that arena while device placement is active. It is not a dense/attention-only prefill path.
Named dense-on-device lever is distinct from prefill-only placement and planner currently refuses it. Prior July boundary-loss comments are upstream evidence, not this laptop measurement.
Pinned Vulkan source contains LIGHTNING_INDEXER/QSA cases. No blanket unsupported-kernel claim follows from the architecture name.
